summary: Represent the two explicitly numbered senses as separate sense-list items.
before: 1. kratzen, ausradieren, auslöschen, jucken; 2. destroy, damn, curse
after: 1) kratzen, ausradieren, auslöschen, jucken; 2) destroy, damn, curse
rationale: The sole structured sense item contains two numbered senses, “1.” and “2.”. Matching example prefixes 1., 2. and 2. also remain in turoyo with sense=null. Split the existing senses and transfer those explicit prefixes into the sense fields. This preserves all wording and adds no sense.
The English verb has its final consonants transposed.
